tenth.songTitle: The Night They Drove Old Dixie Down
tenth.linePrev: In the winter of '65, we were hungry, just barely alive
tenth.line: By May the tenth, Richmond had fell
tenth.lineNext: It's a time I remember, oh so well
stanza: Virgil Caine is the name, and I served on the Danville train
'Til Stonewall's cavalry came and tore up the tracks again
In the winter of '65, we were hungry, just barely alive
By May the tenth, Richmond had fell
It's a time I remember, oh so well
